context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 90 verified all pagination features for ranking tabs. Backend APIs support page/limit params: GET /api/ranking/categoria/{categoria}/{genero}?page=1&limit=20 and GET /api/ranking/povao?genero=M&page=1&limit=20. Both return {ranking, has_more, total_atletas, page}. GET /api/liga-assessorias/ranking does NOT support server-side pagination - it returns all assessorias and frontend handles pagination with displayCount state. Frontend components: RankingProfissional.jsx uses fetchRankingPage(page, reset), RankingGalera.jsx uses fetchRankingPovaoPage(page, reset), RankingEquipes.jsx uses displayCount state for client-side pagination. All 'Carregar mais' buttons have data-testid attributes and work correctly.
